results.title: Forgotten Solidarities
results.overview: A companion film to Miraculous Accident, Forgotten Solidarities returns to Nadir, Edyta, and Jarek from another angle: in 2025, Nadir, a Moroccan former exchange student at Łódź Film School, comes back to Poland to make a film from a buried past shadowed by 1968, where cinema, evidence, and intimacy blur into power, manipulation, and accusation.

results.title: For Worse
results.overview: Lauren, a newly divorced, sober mom, feels like she has a new lease on life after joining her first acting class and starting a fling with her hot, young scene partner. However, when they attend their Gen Z classmate's wedding together, things begin to fall apart, and Lauren finds herself behaving like a drunk 25-year-old bridesmaid. Luckily after a disastrous night she stumbles into a new day and a new beginning.

results.title: Love Kills
results.overview: In downtown São Paulo, absolutely ravaged by crack cocaine, Helena, a young black vampire, wanders around a filthy café trying to captivate Marcos, a naive waiter. As she begins to discover his secrets and the ins and outs of the metropolis, the girl will go on to venture into a dangerous world of immortal intrigues that will challenge her own mortality.

results.title: Lucrum
results.overview: Summoned to the secluded estate of a celebrated pianist, young adoptee June discovers a world of beauty and artistic brilliance sustained by a terrifying covenant. A haunting work of folk horror where refinement masks something far more insatiable.

results.title: Fertile Ground
results.overview: In the near future, a pregnant woman faces an impossible choice in a world gone to ruin.

results.title: EVACATION
results.overview: Unable to let go of his ex-girlfriend Eva, Nick and his brother Michael perform a ritual to bring her back into his life. The ritual works, but what returns isn't her. Now trapped with a seductive and violent entity wearing Eva's face, Nick must confront the true cost of his obsession.

results.title: Phool Pishi O Edward
results.overview: In a zamindar household, a watchful aunt becomes the quiet witness to a mystery that slowly exposes injustice.

results.title: Coconut
results.overview: Nineteen-year-old bedroom rapper Dev has always been called a 'coconut': brown on the outside, white on the inside. Ashamed of his Australian accent and mocked by community members whenever he speaks Fiji Hindi, he has given up on his family's language. His cultural displacement comes to a head when he accidentally ruins his grandpa's Hindu funeral ceremony, knocking the urn containing his ashes into the nearby creek. Everything changes when his sharp-tongued, non-English-speaking grandma hears Dev swear at a stranger and responds in kind. Their new secret language becomes a bridge across grief and a way back into culture and language.

results.title: To Set Upright
results.overview: Paring Bert, a priest, and his parishioner, Santos, a taxi driver, embark on a gritty journey to reconcile their moral conflicts while they elude an assassination attempt.

results.title: Holiness
results.overview: In Sarapampa, preparations for the centenary of the Virgin of the Maize are marred by the visit of the Archbishop. His unfriendly attitude is generating growing discontent among the inhabitants, who remain united to protect the honor of their community.

results.title: Vivian Campbell: Between Stages
results.overview: Def Leppard guitarist Vivian Campbell finally pursues the childhood dream he set aside for music: rally racing, finding in its speed, risk, and total focus a new way to live fully while continuing to live with Hodgkin lymphoma.

results.title: Hussaini
results.overview: Follows Hussaini, an okada (commercial motorcycle) rider trying to make ends meet and protect his pregnant wife, Amina, as life's pressures quietly mount.

results.title: The Tao Exorcist
results.overview: Late at night, a father throws his children into a kiln, muttering, “They’re no longer ours.” Their screams fade into the flames. Young exorcist Xiao Tuo suspects his classmate Nianqi is possessed, uncovering her stepfather Zhen-Kai’s use of dark rituals. As her siblings show disturbing behavior, Zhen-Kai plans a deadly purge. Xiao Tuo links the evil spirit to his own injured father, and together with Nianqi, uncovers a horrifying truth tied to a missing persons case from fifteen years ago.

results.title: Lencería Milagros
results.overview: Mili, third-generation owner of the shop “Lencería Milagros,” is confronted with the imminent closure of the family business. In order to understand herself, she must unravel the secrets her grandmother hid within its walls and objects. An emotional and supernatural journey about identity, memory, and love.

results.title: Turgaud
results.overview: A secretive man arrives at the airport—he has a job interview with the leader of a criminal syndicate. He decides to protect the gangster against the threat of a mysterious woman and her child, who want him dead. Violence is inevitable, but it manifests in enigmatic ways.

results.title: Angh
results.overview: In 1960s Nagaland, a proud Konyak chief struggles to protect his dying traditions when an American missionary arrives with promises of aid that threaten his people’s identity. As his wife’s health deteriorates and famine looms, he and his mute son must make an impossible choice between survival and staying true to their ancestral ways.

results.title: The Conduit
results.overview: After hiring a shadowy company to speak to his deceased son, a grieving father is faced with a sinister force.

In a small town in Michoacán, Genaro—a young father living in the closet—finds himself in a race against time. He has just 72 hours to reach Morelia and obtain post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) following a sexual encounter that turned into an assault—all while trying to fulfill his responsibilities as a father and maintain the image of the “upright man” that everyone expects him to be.
